Tuition fee : 1500 € Tuition fee : per semester. International students who are not citizens of an EU/EEA member state and do not have a German university entrance qualification
Newly enrolled international students not from EU/EEA countries have to pay tuition fees of 1,500 € per semester.

notes: Tuition: the DAAD page states 1,500 EUR per semester for applicants from non-EU countries; the HHN pages confirm this for international students not from EU/EEA without a German HZB. The 188 EUR semester contribution is a separate fee, not tuition. Application channel: DAAD and HHN pages state foreign school-leaving certificates must first be recognised by Studienkolleg Konstanz or uni-assist (uni-assist recognition yields a VPD-style review), so de-uni-assist-vpd was chosen; the portal used to submit the final application is HHN eCampus. Duration 3.5 years (7 semesters / 210 ECTS). Teaching languages: basic studies in English (semesters 1–2), main studies in German (semesters 3–7). Language: for this programme (International Profile) proof of English B2 is required; German A2 is only 'required/recommended, no proof required' (soft, treated as manual_check). The IBIS module handbook PDF is for a different programme (International Business - Intercultural Studies) and was not used.

note.fr: Un certificat officiel d'anglais B2 (TOEFL iBT 79, IELTS Academic 6) est exigé pour ce programme; vérifiez les scores minimaux exacts.
note.en: An official English B2 certificate (TOEFL iBT 79, IELTS Academic 6) is required for this programme; check the exact minimum scores.

note.fr: Des connaissances d'allemand A2 sont mentionnées (recommandées, sans preuve); un cours d'allemand obligatoire est prévu en 1re année et le niveau B2 est nécessaire pour continuer.
note.en: German A2 is mentioned (recommended, no proof); an obligatory German course is in year one and B2 is required to continue.

note.fr: Les candidats internationaux sans diplôme allemand doivent faire reconnaître leur diplôme par Studienkolleg Konstanz ou uni-assist; sans reconnaissance, la candidature n'est pas prise en compte.
note.en: International applicants without a German certificate must have it recognised by Studienkolleg Konstanz or uni-assist; without recognition the application will not be considered.
